purpose: Proof that the H1 verification aggregator never reports a failure, a blocked case or an unreported test as a pass.
method: Two temporary test files (not part of the suite) were injected into tests/verify/, run through report.mjs, then removed. Run dirs were deleted after capturing the outcome; this JSON is the retained evidence.

firstRun.observed: the failing test and its evidence record both reported as fail; overall exit status 1

injected: one test with no evidence record (TAP green)
secondRun.observed: TAP-green blocked case counted as blocked (not pass); TAP-green evidence-less test counted as unreported (not pass); exit status 1

conclusion: The aggregator's fail/blocked/unreported denominators are real and cannot be silently upgraded to pass.
